move: red tile flickers on like a CRT, play triangle draws then pops, press squash, progress bar runs
how: A red rounded tile holding a play-triangle outline path and a filled triangle, a red elliptical glow, two outline rings, a per-letter channel title, a progress bar with a knob and a time readout. 0-10%: the tile opens from a thin line (scaleY .02, scaleX .6->1.05, expo.out) then at 8% expands vertically with elastic.out(1,.5) as the glow blooms from scale .3. At 17% the outline drawSVGs 0->100% (power3.inOut); at 28% the filled triangle pops from scale 0 with back.out(3). At 20% the title letters rise with a 0.025s stagger (expo.out). At 47% a press: tile and triangle squash to .92/.8 (0.12s) and settle with elastic.out(1,.4); rings expand 1->1.4 and 1->1.7 fading (expo.out); the bar fills scaleX 0->.42 linearly over 1.4s while the knob slides and the time counter sets 75 text values from 0:01 to 0:75. Exit at 87%: letters fly up, the tile collapses back to a line (expo.in) then to nothing, the glow and bar fade, and the time resets to 0:00.
adapt: Change the YouTube red (#ff0000), the channel title, the total time text and the bar fill fraction; the triangle can be any play/mark path. Keep the two-stage CRT open (0.3s + elastic), the 0.12s press and the 1.4s bar run.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the tile, rings, bar, split title and time labels inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the open at 0, press at 0.47D, bar 0.5D-0.97D, exit at 0.87D. Register DrawSVGPlugin; scope '#tt', '#t0', '.tv', '.bar' to el and rename ids; the knob travel 640*.42 must follow the mounted bar width.
caveats: the time counter is 75 set() calls; fine on seek but noisy in the timeline
the readout counts to 0:75, which is not a real timestamp
title from() needs immediateRender:false when nested
ends empty, no return to frame one
